title: Compositionality in large pre-trained models
reading: The slide illustrates compositionality in large pre-trained generative models using DALL-E 2 outputs for three prompts, credited to A. Torralba.

visuals.description: Three DALL-E 2 generated images side by side, captioned 'A cup of coffee', 'A cat', and 'A cup of cat'; the third shows a cat's face inside a dark liquid in a cup on a saucer.
visuals.assertion: The model can compose familiar concepts (cup, coffee, cat) into a novel unseen combination, 'a cup of cat'.

concepts.name: Compositionality
concepts.why_it_matters: Generative models can combine known concepts into novel combinations not present in training.

concepts.name: DALL-E 2
concepts.why_it_matters: Example large pre-trained text-to-image model exhibiting compositional generation.
